title: Build an image

checks.name: docker build succeeds
checks.cmd: docker rmi -f z2d-ex-greet >/dev/null 2>&1; docker build -q -t z2d-ex-greet . >/dev/null 2>&1
checks.fail: run it yourself to see the error: docker build -t z2d-ex-greet .

checks.name: with no argument the container prints Hello, world!
an argument replaces the default: Hello, Sam!
the base image is Alpine
checks.cmd: docker run --rm --entrypoint cat z2d-ex-greet /etc/os-release | grep -q Alpine

checks.name: the working directory is /app and greet.sh is in it
checks.cmd: test "$(docker image inspect z2d-ex-greet --format '{{.Config.WorkingDir}}')" = /app && docker run --rm --entrypoint ls z2d-ex-greet /app | grep -qx greet.sh

hints: Start with FROM alpine:3, then WORKDIR /app, then COPY greet.sh .
ENTRYPOINT ["sh", "greet.sh"] is the fixed part of the command.
CMD ["world"] is the default argument, which an argument on the command line replaces.
